title: Bi Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bi Operations Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the\ "last mile\" of data-managinguser feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the\ "boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.

Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring: Executive Assistant — Home Services (Remote, Brazil)

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to be the right hand of a business owner running a fast-growing home services operation in the U.S. market. You'll work directly with the owner — closing deals, running daily operations, and keeping the business moving. If you've sold before and have the numbers to prove it, keep reading.

Compensation — $1,000 to $1,800/month (USD)

Your base is $1,000/month. Your performance moves it up — permanently.

  • $1,000/month base (USD)
  • +$250 permanent raise after closing $5K in revenue
  • +$150 permanent raise after closing $10K in revenue
  • + performance incentives based on deals closed, profit margins, and reviews generated

Hit your numbers and you ramp from $1,000 to $1,800/month. The ceiling moves with you — there's no cap on what a real closer can earn here.

What You'll Do

Sales (core of the role):

  • Handle inbound leads
  • Run outbound outreach (calls, follow-ups, cold calling)
  • Qualify and close high-ticket services ($1K–$5K+)
  • Own and manage the pipeline

Daily Operations:

  • Dispatch service providers and coordinate jobs
  • Collect payment from customers
  • Follow up post-service to make sure customers are satisfied
  • Handle admin tied to the owner's day-to-day

Hiring (when needed):

  • Run end-to-end hiring — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding new team members

Requirements

  • Based in Brazil, working remotely
  • Proven sales background with results you can speak to (mandatory)
  • Strong English — C1 or higher
  • Excellent, reliable internet (non-negotiable)
  • Comfortable working across U.S. time zones
  • Able to run full-cycle sales, not just closing

One Thing to Be Clear About

This is a performance role for people who want to win. You'll be the owner's right hand — sales is the core of the job, but you'll also be the person they trust to keep operations running and the team growing. If you don't have real sales experience and real results, this isn't the seat for you. If you do — this is the kind of role that changes your trajectory.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DevOps Engineer: We are looking for a full-time, remote DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of work experience to work with our U.S. client. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing highly secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platform solutions on AWS. You will collaborate with the Head of DevOps and other technical leaders to build and maintain infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and security processes. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting ISO 27001 / ISMS / SOC2 Type II compliance efforts.This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. While an infrastructure background is beneficial, you should also be comfortable writing scripts and basic software code to enhance and streamline operations.Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australia / New Zealand markets.Responsibilities: Work closely with the Head of DevOps to define detailed technical requirements, plan work, and prioritize tasks according to business needs Design, implement, and maintain AWS cloud platform solutions Ensure strict security compliance and best practices in cloud infrastructure Drive automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and system reliability Strive for zero downtime when deploying solutions or services Develop and own scalable processes for: Capacity planning, Configuration management, Monitoring, and observability Provide day-to-day operational support and perform systems administration tasks Participate in an on-call rotation to support the platform 24/7 Ensure high-quality monitoring coverage for infrastructure and applications Identify potential failure points in infrastructure and proactively develop mitigation strategies Collaborate with internal IT teams for operational support Assist in maintaining compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type II security frameworksRequired Experience: Excellent English communication and collaboration skills 3 to 5 years of DevOps experience Strong AWS experience in infrastructure, security, and automation Technical infrastructure knowledge across servers, storage, and networks Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, etc.) Experience with SQL Comfortable working in high-security and high-compliance environments Hands-on experience scripting and coding for DevOps automation Experience in database administration, performance tuning, and resilience design Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting for large distributed systems Strong networking fundamentals (IP, traffic flow, network ports, protocols likeSMTP, FTP) Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and drive resolution Experience managing large-scale tasks from inception to completion Strong understanding of cloud security principlesDesired Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related fields Experience with automation tooling (e.G., HashiCorp products, configuration management tools) Experience with automated testing in DevOps workflows Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), shift-left principles, and immutable infrastructure Experience working in ISO 27001, PCI compliance, or SOC2 Type II environmentsAdditional Information: Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAPAbout Velozient: We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps. You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.Key Responsibilities Product Design & Development:Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives. Peer Reviews:Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time. Agile Workflow Participation:Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps. Collaboration:Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.QualificationsExperience 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.Technical Skills Proficiency inC# ASP.NET (.NET 8)for web applications and APIs. Experience with.NET MAUIandBlazor Web Applications (.NET 8), leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development. Familiarity withMicrosoft Azureservices, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage. Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.G., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps). Knowledge ofsecure coding practicesand general cybersecurity principles. Experience withcloud platformsandAgile methodologies.Soft Skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.Preferred Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.G., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI). Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.What We Offer Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects. Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation. Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.How We Work Agile Workflow:Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews. Code Standards:Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.G., OWASP, Detectify). Tool Stack:Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies. Team Culture:A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Sr. Compliance Onboarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance Onboarding Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.Key ResponsibilitiesContribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices. Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions. Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions. Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks. Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.What We're Looking ForBachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments. Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly. Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus). Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Devops Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote) We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure automation and CI/CD modernization initiatives. This role will play a critical part in a large-scale migration to Harness, making hands-on Harness experience mandatory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. This engineer will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to streamline deployments, improve reliability, and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.Key Responsibilities: CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Jenkins, and other automation tools. Lead and support migration efforts from legacy deployment tools and pipelines into Harness. Implement deployment automation strategies to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability.Manage Git-based workflows and support DevOps best practices across engineering teams. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tools. Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud and on-premises infrastructure. Support cloud environments including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, and high availability across environments. Containerization & Platform Engineering Deploy and support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. Manage Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and cloud-native deployment strategies. Support platform modernization and enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives. Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system architecture and deployment standards. Monitoring, Security & Operational Support Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime. Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues. Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Documentation & Collaboration Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures. Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards. Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.Qualifications 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles. Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration. Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies. Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy. Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices. Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions. Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices. Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.Preferred Qualifications Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness. Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps. Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet. Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company DescriptionTheta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.We're a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.Role Description We're hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You'll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.You'll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.Additionally, you'll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.What you will work on Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadershipOur Technical Stack Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client Python - scripting, tooling Apache Tomcat - servlet container Java Servlets -request handling PostgreSQL + Hibernate gRPC AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should tooWhat we are looking for We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here's what we care about:Required Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services Working knowledge ofauthentication protocols, and modern web architectureNice to Have Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar) Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deploymentWhy Theta Data Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.Com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company's journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you'll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.

Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you'll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal). Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives. Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.Why Join Us? Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure. Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture. Competitive compensation and benefits package. This is a role based in Brazil, and you'll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you'll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

About Turing:Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. description:

Company Description

Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique U.S. immigration law firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving clients across the United States and globally with 100% remote capability. description:

Role Overview:We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights. Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies. Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies. Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.Desired Skills and Qualifications: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics. Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work. Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.More details on required skills: Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage: Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships. Algebra and Number Theory Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications. Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions. Topology and Geometry Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques. Analysis Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning. Probability and Statistics Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis. Applied Mathematics Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Availability to travel.
- Legally authorized to work in Brazil. What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
- A collaborative and international work environment.
- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects. Why Hoist? If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you. Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Power Bi Developer - Fabric
description:

Power BI Developer – Fabric

About Pyxus

We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!

Job Scope

Leads the operation and maintenance of Microsoft Power BI solutions using Azure Cloud data services. This role will support enterprise data reporting and validate data sets for use by the business using a data lake medallion architecture.Supports the daily reporting based on the Power BI environment for the enterprise.

This is a fully remote position.

The role is focused on providing support to the Morrisville, NC (USA) unit.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy production ready BI and Analytic solutions
  • Active role in data models, tools, processes, project assessment and development process design for the Power BI Environment.
  • Provide technical overviews and tool demonstrations to BI Power Users, Key Business users and Functional owners, communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Diagnose and resolve application bottlenecks and performance issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve production support issues with the Power BI environment.
  • Work closely with Key Business users to understand their challenges and translate them into requirements.
  • Organize, create and maintain critical technical and functional documentation for solutions, including best practices, technical specifications, test plans and training materials.
  • Apply Data Level Security for Power BI solutions
  • Ensure Data Governance methods are applied to Power BI solutions.
  • Experience with SQL and relationship databases.
  • Support versioning, archiving, and deployment workflows Dev / Test / Prod environments
  • Lead the Power BI Community of Excellence (global team of citizen developers and analysts to drive innovation, uphold data governance, and deliver strategic insights)

Qualifications

  • Fluent English
  • BA/BS degree and experience in Information Technology
  • Proven success as a Power BI Developer in a multi-national organization using Power BI software and services.
  • Extensive Knowledge of Power BI, Data Analysis & Interpretation, SQL, Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) and communication/collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Hands on ETL/ELT tools, data integration, data pipelines, metadata tools, and database designs
  • Understanding and use of Python and R software (Preferred)
  • Proactive, great attention to detail, results-oriented problem solver
  • Ability to handle long-term goals along with immediate performance concerns.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and teach others.

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Employee Assistance Program – Mental Health and Well-being

Corporate Time Off Days

This includes Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Race, Ethnicity, and Religion.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.Js and Node.Js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake

Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field

Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong "sense of product" and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We're building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.

About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you're tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You've worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You've owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you've navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You'll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day's work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior's SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture

Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you'll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you'll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us: Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world's leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we've made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. LearnIntroduction: We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you'll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You'll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.Responsibilities: Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna's analytics capabilities.Your profile: 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor's or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English, with additional languages being a plus.**Please submit your CV in English.Our Values: A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caringWhat we offer: At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.Other Benefits:Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

description:

Aqui, você terá espaço para atuar estrategicamente, contribuir com soluções de alto impacto e participar da construção de ambientes cada vez mais escaláveis, seguros e eficientes.Responsabilidades e atribuições Atuar na sustentação e evolução da operação SRE, promovendo confiabilidade, automação e melhoria contínua;

Experiência com stack Elastic (Elasticsearch, Kibana, observabilidade e análise de logs);
Vivência com AKS (AzureKubernetes Service);
Conhecimento em SQL;
Experiência com CosmosDB;

Experiência em análise de incidentes e troubleshooting avançado;

Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;

Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

Zero dress code, vista-se como se sentir mais confortável;
Voucher no dia do aniversário;
Parceria com escola de inglês;
Programa de indicação #amigosv8.Tech;

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the ProductFor more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Role Overview We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilledCloud Systems Engineer (DevOps)to serve as aGCP Specialist and technical builderfor our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable ofbuilding architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts.You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility isleading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.The ideal candidate ensures ourCompute Engineenvironment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions. The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration strategy.Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Networking:Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, includingCloud DNSandCloud NAT. Linux System Administration:Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues. VPN Management:Build and manage secure tunnels usingCloud VPN,pfSensevirtual appliances, andCloudConnexa(OpenVPN) for flexible remote access. Performance Monitoring:Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitorCompute Enginehealth. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance. Resource Management:Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene. Cost Optimization:Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget. Database Oversight:Provide support forPostgreSQLandOracleenvironments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem. Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeterRequired Qualifications Certification:ActiveGoogle Cloud Professional DevOps Engineercertification. Containerization Mastery:Strong expertise withDockerfor containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes. Scripting Mastery:High proficiency inPythonorBashfor automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling. Networking Expertise:Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs usingpfSenseandCloudConnexa. Cloud Migration & Project Leadership:Proven experienceleading and runningapplication and data migrations fromAWStoGCP.This includes the capability toown the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions. Compute Engine Mastery:Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling. English Proficiency:Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have PostgreSQL Expertise:Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning. Oracle Expertise:Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments. Data & Analytics:Familiarity withBigQuery.We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world's leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we've made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn Introduction: We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you'll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You'll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation. Responsibilities: Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. title: Lead Product Designer
description:

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success Remote (Brazil-based) |Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRLWe're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing SaaS business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Following a period of impressive growth, our client is now looking to appoint aProduct Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Successto play a pivotal role in their next phase.This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection ofproduct, clients, and operations —owning the journey from signed deal through to successful platform adoption.The Opportunity As Product Owner, you'll take the lead in ensuring new clients are seamlessly onboarded and set up for success from day one. Working closely with senior leadership, engineering, and customer success, you'll help clients quickly reach their first live auction and build long-term confidence using the platform. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role where you'll: Guide clients through onboarding and implementation Translate real-world client needs into clear product requirements Support ongoing customer success and operational excellence Play a key role in product testing and continuous improvementWhat You'll Be Doing Owning theend-to-end onboarding journeyfrom sales handover to go-live Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice Gathering and definingtechnical and operational requirements Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmapWhat We're Looking For Experience as aProduct Owner, Product Manager, or SaaS Implementation specialist A strong track record incustomer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements Comfortable working cross-functionally withtechnical and non-technical teams Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders Exposure to B2B SaaS, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous.Why Apply? Join ascaling, globally-focused SaaS businessat an exciting stage of growth Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team Have real influence overproduct direction and client success Fully remote role with international collaboration Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platformIf you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Consultor Sap Bcs (Consolidação)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor Sap Bcs (Consolidação) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. 100% Remoto Horário: 09h às 18h Início: Imediato Projeto por tempo indeterminado Espanhol intermediário (desejável)Sobre a oportunidade Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) SAP BCS para atuar na sustentação, estabilização e evolução do processo de consolidação societária em ambiente SAP ECC, garantindo maior previsibilidade, governança e qualidade nos fechamentos contábeis corporativos. O profissional atuará em processos críticos de fechamento financeiro, apoiando as áreas de Contabilidade e Controladoria na análise, correção e prevenção de inconsistências em ambientes integrados SAP ECC, SAP BCS e SAP BW.Principais responsabilidades:
- Sustentação funcional e operacional do SAP BCS
- Atuação em consolidação societária e fechamento contábil
- Conversão de moeda e eliminações intercompany
- Reconciliações contábeis
- Investigação e correção de inconsistências entre ECC, BCS e BW
- Apoio aos usuários durante os fechamentos mensais
- Implementação de melhorias contínuas e automações
- Configuração de versões, hierarquias e regras de consolidação
- Monitoramento de cargas, interfaces e jobs SAP
- Documentação de processos e suporte em KT Requisitos obrigatórios:
- Experiência sólida com SAP BCS
- Conhecimento avançado em: Consolidação societária, IFRS, Fechamento contábil.
- Experiência com SAP ECC FI
- Vivência com: Eliminações intercompany, Conversão de moeda, Estruturas de grupo empresarial.
- Experiência em AMS ou operações críticas de fechamento financeiro
- Forte capacidade analítica e troubleshooting Diferenciais:
- Conhecimento em SAP BW
- Experiência com SAP S/4HANA / Group Reporting
- Vivência em projetos de estabilização, hypercare ou sustentação crítica
- Experiência em ambientes multinacionais e consolidação IFRS
